agent_card.name: OpenAdapt
agent_card.description: Runs compiled OpenAdapt workflows on this computer and checks that they saved. Every run's result carries its signed receipt, and any agent can send a handoff to be verified.

extensions.description: Task results carry the run's record/run/v1 receipt (in-toto Statement in a DSSE envelope) as an openadapt.handoff/v1 artifact part; verify_handoff returns an openadapt.handoff-verdict/v1 verdict.

skills.name: add_triage_note
skills.description: Sandbox: add a triage note to the first referral in a synthetic clinic app. Nothing real changes. Done means: The note is in the synthetic app's record store, confirmed by reading the store directly after the save. Send a data part {"skill": "add_triage_note", "inputs": {...}, "request_id": "..."}. The result includes the run's signed receipt.

skills.name: Verify a handoff
skills.description: Send another agent's result with its receipt (an openadapt.handoff/v1 document, as a data part or a application/vnd.openadapt.handoff+json file part). Returns who signed it, whether it is intact, which checks passed and which were not checked, and any confirmation read from the other party's system. A valid signature proves who signed, not that the claim is true.
